tasks.title: triton-softmax-axis
tasks.prompt: Repair incorrect softmax results while preserving the input shape and normalizing along the requested axis. Inputs are finite contiguous float32 arrays; compare with a float64 CPU stable softmax rounded to float32 at atol 1e-6, rtol 1e-5. 请解释故障、定位来源、引用失败与通过对照，并给出可证伪预测。
tasks.toolExposureScope: Fixed known task pool also used in the agent evaluation; not a new held-out human task corpus.

tasks.title: triton-negative-zero
tasks.prompt: Repair scalar-constant construction so IEEE floating-point signed zero is preserved, while positive zero and nonzero constants remain correct. Exact output bytes are the contract for float16, bfloat16, float32 and float64. 请解释故障、定位来源、引用失败与通过对照，并给出可证伪预测。
tasks.toolExposureScope: Fixed known task pool also used in the agent evaluation; not a new held-out human task corpus.

tasks.title: triton-constexpr-filter
tasks.prompt: Repair constexpr list comprehension semantics: every if predicate filters entries in original order and multiple predicates combine by AND. The device result begins with count, followed by accepted integers and unchanged sentinel -777 for unused capacity. Exact integer equality is required. 请解释故障、定位来源、引用失败与通过对照，并给出可证伪预测。
tasks.toolExposureScope: Fixed known task pool also used in the agent evaluation; not a new held-out human task corpus.

tasks.title: liger-poly
tasks.prompt: Repair PolyNorm forward output: y = w[0]*RMSNormalize(x^3) + w[1]*RMSNormalize(x^2) + w[2]*RMSNormalize(x) + bias, where RMSNormalize(u)=u/sqrt(mean(u^2)+eps). Preserve output shape/dtype and input tensors. Inputs are finite fp16/bf16/fp32; evaluate the mathematical formula on the represented inputs with the stated case tolerances. The public entry point is LigerPolyNormFunction.apply. Backward optimization is outside this task. 请解释故障、定位来源、引用失败与通过对照，并给出可证伪预测。
tasks.toolExposureScope: Fixed known task pool also used in the agent evaluation; not a new held-out human task corpus.

tasks.title: liger-sparse
tasks.prompt: Repair sparsemax forward, the Euclidean projection of each last-axis input row onto the probability simplex. Preserve input tensors, output shape/dtype and the operation for finite fp16/bf16/fp32 values. Public entry point: LigerSparsemaxFunction.apply(x,-1). Case observations include tolerance and complete-output comparison counts. Do not change the test contract. 请解释故障、定位来源、引用失败与通过对照，并给出可证伪预测。
tasks.toolExposureScope: Fixed known task pool also used in the agent evaluation; not a new held-out human task corpus.

tasks.title: liger-grpo
tasks.prompt: Repair fused_selective_log_softmax(logits,input_ids,temperature,mask). Logits are contiguous (B,L+1,V); output is FP32 (B,L), gathering the log-softmax of logits[:,:-1]/temperature at input_ids[:,-L:]. Where a supplied mask[:,-L:] is false, output is zero. Valid strided or broadcast ID/mask views are supported independently; mask may be None. Preserve inputs. Error tolerance is atol=rtol=2e-5. 请解释故障、定位来源、引用失败与通过对照，并给出可证伪预测。
tasks.toolExposureScope: Fixed known task pool also used in the agent evaluation; not a new held-out human task corpus.
